name: pokeldn
subtitle: Trade and send gifts to Pokemon games over local wireless
description:
pokeldn speaks Nintendo Switch local wireless to Pokemon games on a real console: trades in both roles, Mystery Gifts and more, for FireRed and LeafGreen through Legends Z-A.

The radio is an ESP32 board running pokeldn's Bluetooth radio firmware; the phone talks to it over Bluetooth. You supply prod.keys dumped from your own console.
